Microsoft (MSFT) Valuation Rose While Smith Salley & Associates Decreased Its Position; Appleton Partners Has Increased Its Sherwin Williams Co Com (SHW) Holding 
March 12, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Appleton Partners Inc increased its stake in Sherwin Williams Co Com (SHW) by 7.26% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Appleton Partners Inc bought 1,195 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.75% with the market. The institutional investor held 17,656 shares of the building materials company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.32 million, up from 16,461 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Appleton Partners Inc who had been investing in Sherwin Williams Co Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $39.00B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.96% or $4.0545   $417.1055. About 208,851 shares traded. The Sherwin-Williams Company (NYSE:SHW) has risen 15.27%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.43% the S&P500. 
Smith Salley & Associates decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 6.37% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Smith Salley & Associates sold 19,110 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.75% with the market. The institutional investor held 281,050 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $20.94M, down from 300,160 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Smith Salley & Associates who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $746.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.42   $96.96. About 14.66 million shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 34.52%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.82% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in Accenture Plc Ireland Shs Clas (NYSE:ACN) by 3,700 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 29,879 shares, and cut its stake in Medtronic Plc Shs (NYSE:MDT).
